name: const unsafe fn from_mut_ptr_range < 'a , T > (range : Range < * mut T >) -> & 'a mut [T]
rule: For safety, range.start must be valid and properly aligned for T and point to the first element of the slice.
api: const unsafe fn from_mut_ptr_range < 'a , T > (range : core::ops::range::Range < * mut T >) -> & 'a mut [T]
expression: No faithful DSL expression exists: the grammar exposes only pointer-slot storage for range.start, not its pointee validity, pointee alignment, or address needed to identify the slice’s first element.
